My treatment included preparation for jaw surgery, so it was more complicated than a typical orthodontic case. Dr. Mia worked closely with my surgeon to make sure everything was ready before surgery, and after I came back she carefully adjusted my bite until everything fit together perfectly.

I initially started with Invisalign, which did not work well for me, and I ended up switching to traditional braces. This required an additional $1,500 on top of the $4,000 I had already paid, bringing my total to $5,500. I was told my treatment with braces would take about 7 months.

At my second-to-last appointment, I expressed concerns that my teeth were not fully aligned—specifically a crooked bottom tooth and some spacing. Despite bringing this up, my braces were removed at the end of the 7 months, and my teeth are still not where they should be. The bottom tooth is improved but not straight, and there are still noticeable gaps.

For the amount of money and time invested, I expected a more complete result or at least a clear plan to address the remaining issues before removal.

I also contacted their hotline to raise these concerns and was told I would receive a follow-up, but it has now been 7 days with no response.

As consistent with other negative reviews for this office, the customer service and patient care is horrendous. I was in contact with the assistant general manager at this office and she was incredibly unprofessional and rude. If she is a reflection of this office's culture and vision, there is absolutely zero care for patients and their needs. I understand you are running a business, but at the end of the day, you are a medical provider that ought to communicate with decency and have some semblance of caring for people .. as people. I felt incredibly dehumanized when I was speaking with this assistant general manager.

The assistant general manager is refusing care because I asked for clarification on why they were charging me a comprehensive ortho fee when I likely have less than a year of treatment left (currently on Invisalign but am looking to move offices and providers because I was not happy with my current provider). I was looking to come back to this office because Dr. Chiang had originally started my case three years ago at the original office I was at. I asked the assistant general manager if she could provide more clarity on why MBO was not able to charge a fairer price for my treatment as I've already been on Invisalign for nearly three years and should be at the tail-end of my treatment. She gave me vague answers (as well as the staff sometime last year) which led us to talking in circles. We ended the convo with me asking if she could see if they could do anything about the cost (I asked respectfully and would have accepted MBO's final answer either way). We ended the call amicably with her apologizing for her tone and demeanor.

Instead, a few days later she calls back and says its in her authority to deny me treatment. Felt pretty blind-sided by her call because this is not where we had left things off. She refused to really provide any explanation as to why she was refusing treatment, but said that she had been thinking about our phone call for a couple days (maybe because I have a valid point in my concerns and ask about the price???). She was really nasty to deal with on this phone call and kept insisting she owed me zero explanation as to why she was refusing treatment. My sense is that it's because I asked if they would consider adjusting the price. Refusing treatment for this reason seems very petty and I wonder if this response is a reflection of MBO's lack of respect for patients. I mean you can even see how the head ortho has responded to other negative reviews. Full of defensiveness.

Maybe I'm overstepping here, but I just don't understand why people go into the medical profession if they lack empathy for people. There are many other ways to make money. Even faster ways to make money without going into medicine. At the end of the day, if you have the audacity to treat patients with disrespect and no care for their medical needs, you really shouldn't be in medicine. I say this because at the end of our phone call, I explained I hadn't seen an ortho since last summer and if she had any other recommendations for a different ortho, she just flat out said no and said "I'm not sure why you're still talking to me". I've never seen this type of behavior from any medical office.","Images":null,"When":"4 months ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xSdFFWQnVhazVSTFhsUWMxZEhUekJDY2tkQk5HYxAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":1,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115593966792446992882/reviews?hl=en-GB","posted_at_unix_micros":1775848927782486,"updated_at_unix_micros":1775848927782486,"language":"en","translated_lang":"","text_original":"AVOID THIS PRACTICE AT ALL COSTS!!
